parts.html: The K-41 kitchen is a modern straight design with a contrasting combination of dark graphite upper cabinets and a light furniture base. The upper fronts have a subtle wood texture that adds depth to the dark surface. The lower cabinets, tall side sections, and the open niche on the right in the upper row are all finished in the same light shade, close to milky white.

What sets the K-41 apart is its precise distribution of color. The dark upper row forms a bold horizontal line, while the light fronts of the lower section and tall cabinets visually lighten the composition. The open light-colored niche on the right continues the finish of the lower cabinets and side sections — it has no separate woodgrain decor.

The dark countertop with a black marble pattern connects the two contrasting tiers. The light veining on its surface echoes the white fronts and backsplash, creating a cohesive design without unnecessary decorative elements.

This combination can complement a modern minimalist interior in an apartment, condo, or private home. The K-41 kitchen also works well in an open-plan kitchen and living area, where the furniture composition becomes part of the overall design of the living space.
Layout and dimensions

The K-41 kitchen is 4.2 linear meters long. The straight configuration places the furniture along a single wall. The main work surfaces, upper and lower cabinets, tall side sections, and spaces for built-in appliances form a single functional line.
Overall dimensions of the standard model: 4.2 × 2.4 × 0.6 m.

In the visualization provided, a built-in oven is located on the left in a tall light-colored section. The central part is taken up by the work surface with the cooking zone and sink. On the right, the composition is completed by a tall light-colored section, while the open niche in the upper row provides space for dishes and everyday items.
When the kitchen is made to order, the placement of appliances, the sink, cabinets, and work areas can be adapted to the room dimensions and existing utility connections.
A separate kitchen island is not included in the standard K-41 configuration.
Materials and decorative finish

Both upper and lower fronts are made of laminated chipboard, but their finishes differ: the closed upper cabinets are a very dark graphite with a wood texture, while the lower cabinets and tall side sections have a light solid-color decor.

The open niche on the right in the upper row is finished in the same light color as the lower cabinets and tall side sections. This ties the different parts of the furniture together and softens the contrast between the dark top and the light bottom.
The kitchen carcass is made of 18 mm laminated chipboard.

The countertop is chipboard-based, with a dark decorative black marble-look surface. The visualization shows light veining that accentuates the surface pattern. The stone texture is part of the decor: natural marble is not specified as the material of the standard countertop.
The light backsplash echoes the solid-color finish of the lower cabinets. A black faucet and a built-in oven complement the contrasting palette.
Functionality and standard hardware

The K-41 is designed for built-in appliances. The specific set of appliances and their placement are agreed upon during custom design; the reference to built-in installation does not mean that the appliances themselves are included in the standard furniture price.
The standard configuration includes a cargo pull-out. It provides additional pull-out storage for food and kitchen utensils.
Hinged fronts are fitted with Hettich hinges with soft-close mechanisms, and pull-out elements with concealed Quadro Hettich slides.
Concealed installation allows the slides to be mounted beneath the pull-out elements, keeping the cabinet interior neat.
Cabinet handles are included. There are no lift-up mechanisms.

At the client’s request, the K-41 kitchen can be adapted in terms of functionality and materials. More functional cabinet hardware, upgraded opening mechanisms, and additional storage systems are available. The kitchen can also be made from alternative materials, from more budget-friendly to premium options.
These solutions are selected separately depending on your preferences, the specifics of the room, and the project budget, and are not included in the stated standard configuration.

Custom K-41 kitchen in Bratislava and Vienna
DUMSKAYA DESIGN designs and makes custom kitchens for apartments, condos, and private homes in Bratislava and Vienna.

The K-41 can be adapted to the specific dimensions of your room by changing the length of the furniture composition and the placement of built-in appliances, cabinets, and storage systems. When ordering, you can choose other shades of graphite and light fronts, countertop and carcass materials, and additional hardware.

We offer furniture design, selection of materials and hardware, manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation. At the client’s request, we can also select a sink, faucet, range hood, and appliances.
